display.purpose: Hero statements on marketing surfaces only.

body.purpose: Copy at 65-75ch max, never below the contrast floor.

shadows.name: ai-glow-subtle
shadows.purpose: Resting AI prompt input. Only AI elements glow.

motion.name: ease-panel
motion.purpose: Panel expansion (AI input pill to panel), 0.5s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill, paper-white on ink-black. Main call to action in-app.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #EAEAEA; color: #121212; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet pill for secondary actions and inactive tabs.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #8a8a8a; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 24px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #ffffff; }

components.name: Tab Pill Group
components.description: Segmented pill switcher; active tab inverts to paper-white.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: #282828; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #8a8a8a; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-tab-active { background: #EAEAEA; color: #121212; }

components.name: AI Prompt Input
components.description: Signature input: pill with AI duotone glow. The only glowing element in the system.
components.html: ✦
components.css: .ds-ai-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #282828; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(36,153,49,0.15), 0 0 30px rgba(113,130,255,0.15); } .ds-ai-field { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.9375rem; outline: none; } .ds-ai-field::placeholder { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-ai-spark { color: #7182FF; } .ds-ai-input:focus-within { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(36,153,49,0.4), 0 0 60px rgba(113,130,255,0.4); }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Raised tile with 16:9 preview area; tonal elevation, no shadow.
components.html: Q3 Pitch Deck
components.css: .ds-card { background: #282828; border: 1px solid #666666; border-radius: 15px; padding: 6px; width: 240px; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #333333; } .ds-card-preview { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: #0a0a0a; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #4A4A4A; } .ds-card-row { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 4px 2px; } .ds-card-title { color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Quiet pill search; no glow (search is not AI).
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #282828; border: 1px solid #4A4A4A; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-search-field { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.9375rem; outline: none; } .ds-search-field::placeholder { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-search-icon { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #8a8a8a; }

narrative.overview: slides+ is a dark theater where the decks are the performers. The interface is matte near-black, quiet and flat, so every slide reads like a lit stage against it. Typography carries hierarchy, whitespace carries rhythm, and color is reserved for moments where AI is present.
keyCharacteristics: Matte near-black canvas; content provides all the color
AI duotone (#7182FF + #249931) only where AI acts
Flat by default — tonal layering instead of shadows

rules.name: The AI Duotone Rule
rules.body: Periwinkle and green belong to AI features exclusively. If a surface has no AI in it, it stays grayscale.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text never drops below 4.5:1. On #121212 that means white at >=62% opacity; white/40 is prohibited for copy.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter only. A second typeface is a redesign decision, not a page decision.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-AI Rule
rules.body: If it glows, AI is involved. Nothing else glows.

dos: Do keep the canvas matte #121212 and let slides provide the color
Do use tonal layering (#282828 + hairline border) for raised surfaces
Do keep body text at or above rgba(255,255,255,0.62) on dark
Do use real rendered decks/templates as hero content
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion alternative
donts: Don't use uppercase tracked eyebrows or 01/02/03 numbered scaffolding
Don't build identical icon+heading+text card grids
Don't cast black drop shadows; step the gray ramp instead
Don't ship copy below the contrast floor (text-white/40 on black)
Don't let WebGL/gradient backgrounds compete with content
